versions.description: Risk and reward for your economy. crime is a quick gamble: most times you get away with a reward, sometimes you pay a fine. rob <player> steals a share of an online player's wallet; if you get caught, you pay the victim a fine instead. Only the wallet can be robbed: savings in the bank module are always safe, which gives players a reason to bank. Cooldowns per robber, a protection window for victims, a minimum victim wallet and a ROB_IMMUNE permission for staff or VIPs keep it fair. Optional: failed crimes and robberies send the player to jail when the registry jail module is installed (skipped when it is not). crimestats shows your record and cooldowns. Works on every game.

commands.name: crime
commands.description: Try a quick crime: win a reward or pay a fine
commands.helpText: Do a crime. You may get a reward or pay a fine. Has a cooldown.

commands.name: rob
commands.description: Try to steal from an online player's wallet
commands.helpText: /rob <player>: steal a share of their wallet. If you get caught you pay them a fine. Bank savings are safe.

commands.name: crimestats
commands.description: Your crime and robbery record, and your cooldowns
commands.helpText: Shows your crimes, robberies, fines, losses and when you can go again.
